provenance.task: skill-effect parity gap: 43 skills of the 2019 GRF SKILL_EFFECT_INFO_LIST have official effect ids but no layer facts because their visuals are hard-coded in the client (never present in the effect table / roBrowserLegacy dump).
provenance.method: For every gap effect id: EffectTypes.h maps the id to EF_*; the effect implementation (the `case EF_*` switch of CRagEffect::OnProcess/OnProcess2/OnProcess3 and the helper it calls, or the dedicated CEffect subclass registered in EffectLists::RegisterAllocators) gives the files, colours, duplicate counts and blend; EffectTypes.cpp BuildLifetimes gives the frame lifetime (60 fps -> ms) where it is a plausible value, otherwise the class `effectLifetime` is used.
provenance.line_numbers: `source` of every entry names the file and line of the switch case and of the helper/method that sets each asset. All paths below are relative to the read-only decompilation checkout `Source/Contents/Effects/`.
provenance.schema: Same layer facts schema as `tools/windows_client_effect_layers.json` (`type` STR/SPR/3D, `file`, `duplicate`, `duration`, `alphaMax`, `red`/`green`/`blue`, `blendMode`), so `tools/gen_rodecomp_effect_layers.py` converts them with the exact same rules as the official-table lane (`tools/gen_skill_effect_layers.build_layer`): world units x2 for offsets/radii, size*0.85 for billboards, size*0.09 for projectiles, data\texture\ / data\sprite\ / data\texture\effect\ roots.
provenance.assets: Every file name was validated against the CondaRO.grf / data.grf / palettes.grf archives. The shared GRF name reader (tools/gen_skill_effect_layers.read_grf_names) decodes the name table as UTF-8, falls back to EUC-KR (the encoding the client loader uses; the Korean names here are CP949-compatible) and finally latin-1; the Korean texture/sprite names resolved through that path. tools/gen_rodecomp_effect_layers.py re-validates every emitted asset on each run.
provenance.scope: `scope.skills` is the exact 43-skill list of `tools/skill_parity_report.json` rows with has_descriptor=false.
provenance.note: Sizes are effect-table units (the generator applies the official conversion); durations are milliseconds. Only assets that really ship in the GRFs are used; effects without a file layer are listed in `skipped_effect_ids` and skills without a fixed visual in `skipped_skills` instead of inventing something.

3020.name: KO_ZENKAI
3020.reason: the 2019 GRF table carries no effect id. The client plays a server-selected element: CellRangeEffect.cpp:39-49 uses effect\water-%d.bmp / stone-%d.bmp / fire-%d.bmp / lightning-%d.bmp for EF_KO_ZENKAI_WATER/LAND/FIRE/WIND. There is no fixed asset, and spawning all four rune circles would be wrong, so the skill stays without a descriptor.
